policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.

DEEPLEARNING_EXAMPLES_DIR.holds: a clone of https://github.com/NVIDIA/DeepLearningExamples.git at commit 729963dd47e7c8bd462ad10bfac7a7b0b604e6dd, the directory language/bert/pytorch_SUT.py imports from as language/bert/DeepLearningExamples; the pinned repository lists it in .gitmodules but does not track it, so it is not in ./repo

policy.forbidden: the MLPerf Inference results repositories (mlcommons/inference_results_*), published MLPerf submissions, or the MLCommons results tables

tasks.task_prompt: Run `python3 run.py --backend=pytorch --accuracy` (scenario Offline, the default) on the BERT-Large fp32 model in MODEL_DIR over the SQuAD v1.1 validation set, then accuracy-squad.py (which calls evaluate_v1.1.py) on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.pytorch device:: the device the model's parameters are on
